sources.entry: YYLO CLI - Command-line orchestrator for coding agents with isolated task worktrees, Kanban task state, and a typed merge queue.
YYLO - Open-source command-line orchestrator for coding agents like Pi and Codex, with typed task, validation, merge, and release-readiness boundaries across isolated git worktrees. #free #opensource

summary.one_liner: YYLO CLI is an open-source command-line orchestrator that runs coding agents, manages typed tasks in isolated git worktrees, and gates changes through validation and merge steps.
summary.what_it_does: YYLO provides the `yylo` and `yy` commands (with `ypl` as a shortcut for `yy pi --live`) to drive coding agents such as Pi and Codex. It initializes a repository workspace under `.juno_task/` and runs agents or command-based loops with bounded iterations, optionally from a YAML workflow file. Feature work is organized as tasks: `task start` creates an isolated git worktree, `task finish` verifies a clean committed result and queues it, and `merge land` integrates one task using native Git with expected-old ref protection. It also records validation evidence tied to exact inputs (`evidence run|status|await`), provides read-only observation of run evidence (`watch`), and includes a workspace topology checker (`doctor workspace`). YYLO Ledger (task/record store) and YYLO Benchmark (evaluation) are separate packages that `yy ledger` and `yy benchmark` delegate to.
use_cases: orchestrate coding agents from the terminal
run isolated feature tasks in separate git worktrees
gate repository changes with validation evidence before merging
run repeatable agent and test loops from a YAML workflow
inspect and guard integration of task branches into a target branch
track tasks and records in a Git-native ledger
how_to_run: mkdir yylo-demo && cd yylo-demo && git init
yy init --task "Document the onboarding path" --subagent pi
stack: YYLO Ledger (Python, yylo-ledger on PyPI, pinned 0.4.0)
notable: Typed task lifecycle (start, finish, merge land, merge project) with isolated git worktrees per task
Content-addressed validation evidence tied to exact inputs
Watch commands observe existing run evidence read-only and never launch or retry work
Ledger references in prompts (##slug) hydrate Records with bounded size and time limits
Workspace relocation tooling with plan, apply, and verify receipts
caveats: Requires separately installed Ledger 0.4.0 exactly and Benchmark 0.2.1 exactly for the unreleased 0.2.12 source; older versions are rejected
Agent skills are distributed separately in yylo-dev/yylo-skills and need a network install step
Provider credentials and model availability for agents are configured externally
The README describes this source as unreleased; the stable npm channel is 0.2.2 at time of writing
keywords: run ai agent on my repo
